$provenance.derivation: Hand-authored per D21. The ORDERS_FULFILLED sample's top-level key set was diffed against ORDERS_PAID and found IDENTICAL — zero keys differ — so this recording reuses that key set and differs only in the fulfilment-bearing members. Values are invented. No live capture (D3).
caveats: Shopify's own ORDERS_FULFILLED sample is not actually fulfilled: it shows fulfillment_status: null and fulfillments: []. So the published page gives NO element shape for a fulfilled order's fulfillments array.

The seven-key fulfillment element below (created_at, id, order_id, status, tracking_company, tracking_number, updated_at) is the abbreviated form printed on the REST Order resource page. The standalone REST Fulfillment resource carries a much larger set, and which one a real webhook embeds is NOT DOCUMENTED. The stub emits exactly these seven rather than guessing at the larger shape.
Everything in webhook_orders_paid.json's caveats applies here too; the top-level shape is the same object.
